title: Tableau Permission and Role Change Audit
dataSources: Tableau logs (`tableau:httpd`, `tableau:vizportal`, `tableau:backgrounder`), REST API, and `workgroup` repository tables via DB Connect.
app: Tableau Server logs via Universal Forwarder; Tableau Server REST API and TSM metrics via HEC; `workgroup` repository via Splunk DB Connect.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=tableau:httpd (action="*permission*" OR action="*grant*" OR action="*group*")
| stats count as changes, values(action) as actions by user
| sort - changes
description: Audits Tableau events that grant, revoke or modify permissions and roles, giving a change trail for least-privilege reviews and incident investigation.
value: Unreviewed permission changes are a leading cause of data-access incidents; an audit trail for Tableau supports governance and rollback.
implementation: Ingest Tableau admin/audit events; schedule daily and alert on privilege grants made outside an approved change window.
visualization: Table of actor by change count with actions, timeline.
grandmaExplanation: We keep a record of who changes access and permissions in Tableau so unexpected changes can be traced.
